notes.title: Play NO EXIT PLATEST NOW! (Full chapter 1 and 2)
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]PLAYTEST IS OUT RIGHT NOW![/b][/u][/h1][previewyoutube="B_dL-rIXhuU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]NO EXIT Chapter 1 and 2 are out right now![/b][/h2][p]
…Or rather, they’ve actually been out for around 2 weeks already.[/p][p]You may be wondering why I didn’t make an announcement here earlier. Well, giving myself some time after publishing allowed me to make extra changes, fix bugs, and polish rough edges! That’s why I think now is finally the right time to make a proper announcement here.
[/p][p][b]What’s in the Playtest?
[/b]
In this playtest, you can play through the full [b]CHAPTER 1[/b] and [b]CHAPTER 2[/b]. If you’re out of the loop, that’s 2 out of 3 chapters.[/p][p]Currently, after a big break, I’ll be starting the long journey of developing [b]CHAPTER 3[/b] (c’mon, I’ve been working on this game for 3 years now, I needed a break, lmao).[/p][p]But worry not! I plan to keep you updated on Chapter 3’s development as it goes on, including later in this post.[/p][p]First, let’s talk about what’s actually included [b]in the PLAYTEST[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]CHAPTER 1[/b][/h2][p][b]Chapter 1 includes around 20 minutes of gameplay and serves as a prologue to the game’s story![/b]
In this chapter, you’ll encounter [b]2 chase sequences[/b], [b]a small boss encounter[/b], lots of spooks, and even some exploration. It also introduces the phone’s first ability: [b]FLASH![/b][/p][p]This chapter also features the [b]first and for now, only CD Disc[/b] in the game (the full release will include more).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/68a29cf974481d80f695ee966d31fcf797661e30.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/acd89b208ecf2dd3c62bfa0ee9cab194c1a7e2fa.png"][/img]^ ^ ^ Some cool Chapter 1 Screenshots ^ ^ ^[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]CHAPTER 2[/b][/h2][p][b]Chapter 2 continues the story, introducing the main villain along with three very important characters who play a key role in the plot.[/b][/p][p]In this chapter, you'll face 3 challenging boss encounters, with funky reactive music! As well as 3 chases, some spooks, easy yet fun puzzles and fun lore![/p][p]This chapter also introduces the phone’s second ability: [b]SONAR.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/3bf7327a079d877b98d4c98e383c91580403465b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/5250ca5b1c19ad343efc0cd7b558599ef1481b12.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/6b8cf1170adec0b797e846d42aa07df951ddf2e4.png"][/img]^ ^ ^ Some cool Chapter 2 Screenshots ^ ^ ^[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]What's up with [b]CHAPTER 3?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Well, I can definitely make a few promises. I can’t guarantee I’ll deliver on [i]all[/i] of them, but I’ll try, I always do!
[i](DONT UNBLUR IF YOU HAVEN’T PLAYED THE PLAYTEST YET)[/i][/p][list][*][p][spoiler][b]Knowledge's and Chekov's[/b] relations ship expanded.[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler][b]2 brand-new characters[/b], plus some returning familiar faces from both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2![/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]4 brand-new complex areas![/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]The story will be [b]fully finished[/b], with a proper closure — no cliffhangers![/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]A [b]full original score[/b] composed by my [i]extremely talented[/i] friend, Kai [i]“Kaiser”[/i] Ronan![/p][/*][*][p][spoiler][b]Dealmaker’s real name revealed[/b] …and let’s just say, he’s [i]extremely[/i] pissed at you :3[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Here's some screenshots for you all...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/1ef2dd56d8bca5342f097e3b83203f77934f6d7a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/e17b2849bb85410dcc53a12f851ca0ab3494c9cd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/51478c074d31c9317521336a528f9dd910321e73.png"][/img][b]ALL OF THESE SCREENSHOTS ARE SUBJECTS [/b][/p][p][/p][p]If you wanna be updates with the news, click these links![/p][p]
My youtube channel:[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@BartBartGames?sub_confirmation=1" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff0000"]YOUTUBE CHANNEL[/url][/p][p]Official Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/c6kh2jjNtd" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff0000"]DISCORD[/url][/p][p]My TWITTER/X account:
[url="https://x.com/BartBartGames" style="button" buttoncolor="#d60000"]TWITTER[/url][/p][h3]
[b]Thank you for reading that annoucement, and have a GREAT day, night, evening, noon, afternoon, night, all that![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]See you soon, Chekov...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/de0e893bc7d112071dc2bb8d50f601c2af266453.png"][/img]

[/p]

tags.feature: In this playtest, you can play through the full CHAPTER 1 and CHAPTER 2.
Chapter 1 includes around 20 minutes of gameplay and serves as a prologue to the game’s story!
This chapter also features the first and for now, only CD Disc in the game (the full release will include more).
Chapter 2 continues the story, introducing the main villain along with three very important characters who play a key role in the plot.
This chapter also introduces the phone’s second ability: SONAR.
Knowledge's and Chekov's relations ship expanded.
2 brand-new characters, plus some returning familiar faces from both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2!
The story will be fully finished, with a proper closure — no cliffhangers!
A full original score composed by my extremely talented friend, Kai “Kaiser” Ronan!
Dealmaker’s real name revealed …and let’s just say, he’s extremely pissed at you :3
